limitations: Categories designate the intended perturbation type; all returned clean statements are labeled supported.
Constructed excerpts are identified in evidence_reason. Preserve original article and paragraph context for pronouns and contextual references.

For controls with an additional english_claim_id, original_id identifies the queue case supplying the source, not the English claim to copy. Retrieve that specified claim and preserve its own citation metadata.

Counterparts are exact complete rendered claims from cached Finnish or Swedish articles. Some contain additional details beyond the supported English statement; those additional details are not independently endorsed by this labeling.
Märket dimensions require straightforward imperial-to-metric conversion and retain approximate wording.
All 40 clean texts, literal evidence quotes, same-URL English citations and eight counterpart identities were checked read-only. No detector output or prompt was inspected.
